links.outcome: Readability of original IR procedure descriptions (FRE, Gunning Fog, ARI)
links.effect: Original text FRE 47.2 (Difficult); GF 14.4 and ARI 11.2 grade level, well above patient literacy; ChatGPT simplification improved to FRE 78.4, GF 7.8, ARI 5.8 (p<0.001).
links.quote: The original FRE score was 47.2 (Difficult), improved to 78.4 (Fairly Easy) by ChatGPT.

links.outcome: Reading grade level after prompting ChatGPT to simplify to fifth-grade level
links.effect: GF and ARI dropped from 14.4 and 11.2 to 7.8 and 5.8 after simplification (p<0.001); FRE 47.2 to 78.4.
links.quote: GF and ARI scores dropped from 14.4 and 11.2 to 7.8 and 5.8, respectively, after simplification, showing significant improvement (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reliability/credibility (DISCERN) of AI-simplified text versus original
links.effect: Average DISCERN score decreased from 3.73 to 2.99 (p<0.001) after ChatGPT simplification, indicating reduced reliability.
links.quote: However, the average DISCERN score decreased from 3.73 to 2.99 (p < 0.001) post-ChatGPT simplification.
